title: Push method
description: Where a mapper sends the readings of one device property. At most one destination branch is set; the choice is made by whoever writes the device resource.

http.description: Post readings to an HTTP endpoint the operator names.

request-path.description: Path appended to the host. Wire key: requestPath.

mqtt.description: Publish readings to an MQTT broker of the operator's choosing. Unrelated to the eventbus module's own broker.

topic.description: Topic the readings are published on.

qos.description: MQTT quality of service for the publish.

retained.description: Whether the broker retains the last reading.

db-method.description: Write readings into one of four databases. Wire key: dbMethod.

influxdb2-client-config.description: Wire key: influxdb2ClientConfig. The write token is not here — it is read from the mapper's environment.

redis-client-config.description: Wire key: redisClientConfig. The password is not here — it is read from the mapper's environment.

tdengine.description: Wire key: TDEngine in the Kubernetes resource, tdengine in the DMI protobuf description.

td-engine-client-config.description: Wire key: TDEngineClientConfig. Credentials are read from the mapper's environment.

mysql-client-config.description: Wire key: mysqlClientConfig. The password is read from the mapper's environment.

anomaly-detection.description: Not a destination: configuration for detection logic the mapper runs itself, introduced in v1.23.0. Wire key: anomalyDetection.
